fields.declaredAge: Required integer, product minimum 15; private self-declaration, not verified age
fields.countryCode: Required ISO country code chosen by user, never inferred from language or GPS
fields.subdivisionCode: Optional catalog code; reset when country changes

storage.current: Not implemented; Firebase Authentication does not store these fields
storage.draft: Memory only until eligible authenticated persistence is appropriate
storage.authority: Server validates eligibility against a reviewed country/age policy; never trust client adult flags
storage.age_transition: Reconfirm age when an adult-only feature is requested; no guessed birthday or automatic age increment
storage.ranking: No public projection or participation enabled by this form

release_gate: Reviewed country policies required. Unknown policies fail closed. Fictional MX render is not launch approval.
